title: Kenya's Adaptation Communication to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Climate exposure, drought impacts and adaptation actions reported in the 2024 communication
methodology: Government communication synthesizing climate, sector and stakeholder evidence and consultations.
limitations: Program-effectiveness findings draw on consultations, not controlled evaluation.

title: Kenya's Second Nationally Determined Contribution, 2031-2035
temporal_coverage: Observed climate, disaster impacts, and projections through 2035 reported in 2025
methodology: National contribution summarizes trends, projections, disaster impacts and adaptation priorities.
limitations: Impacts cite other sources; 2031-2035 priorities are plans, not evaluated results.

title: Turkana County Participatory Climate Risk Vulnerability Assessment Report
temporal_coverage: Participatory assessment of historical/current conditions and RCP4.5/RCP8.5 projections through 2100
methodology: Participatory assessment with surveys, KIIs and FGDs across 30 wards.
limitations: Perception-based; proposed actions are not evaluated.

title: Turbulent waters, troubled shores: the twin threats of climate change and conflict on vulnerable communities around Lake Turkana
temporal_coverage: Conflict analysis published 2026; report covers Lake Turkana Basin communities
methodology: International Alert conflict analysis commissioned by WFP; publisher page summarizes climate, environmental, economic and social drivers.
limitations: Only substantive publisher-page summary was inspected; full report PDF was not accessible in this session.

title: Facing old and new risks in arid environments: The case of pastoral communities in Northern Kenya
temporal_coverage: Structured review of longstanding and emerging risks, drawing on literature available through 2023
methodology: Structured literature review spanning pastoralism, climate security, conflict, conservation and large energy projects.
limitations: Synthesis of literature rather than new household fieldwork; authors note contested climate-conflict mechanisms.

title: Climate governance in Kenya
temporal_coverage: Self-reported programming and policy processes, including Samburu work during 2018-2022
methodology: Organization's public description of its county-level climate governance and peacebuilding work.
limitations: Self-reported program description without independent outcome evaluation on the inspected page.

title: Local forms of resilience in pastoral areas: a scoping study in Northern Kenya - Final Report
organization: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research
temporal_coverage: Scoping study of local resilience in northern pastoral areas, published 2023
methodology: Scoping study; publisher summary describes northern Kenya local resilience actors and program implications.
limitations: Only the publisher's report description was inspected; detailed methods and findings were not available in the excerpt.
